cohort: 838 women with singleton, cephalic pregnancies who had an emergency cesarean section
finding: IFH at CS was independently associated with an increased risk of uterine extensions and a composite adverse perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: Impacted fetal head (IFH) at caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of uterine extensions and adverse perinatal outcomes, independent of cesarean section at full dilation.
